subject: How configure in shiny-server pro for using multi R process an application?

messages.author: bcb2af8a810c3eee
messages.subject: How configure in shiny-server pro for using multi R process an application?
parts:
Hi~
I will have plan to buy shiny-server pro.
so do testing to know difference between shiny-server and shiny-server pro.

especially, about multi R process an application..

but I don't know benefits of shiny pro about multi R process.
As a result of monitoring, it have one R process per an application.

Who can you give me a sample configure file or example configure for multi R process?

Is this part of the setting it is below the one I'm looking for?

# Define the user we should use when spawning R Shiny processes
run_as shiny;

# Define a top-level server which will listen on a port
server {
  # Instruct this server to listen on port 3838
  listen 3838;

  # Define the location available at the base URL
  location / {
    #### PRO ONLY ####
    # Only up tp 20 connections per Shiny process and at most 3 Shiny processes
    # per application. Proactively spawn a new process when our processes reach 
    # 90% capacity.
    utilization_scheduler 20 .9 3;
    #### END PRO ONLY ####

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: How configure in shiny-server pro for using multi R process an application?
parts:
Let's say your app has a plotting function that takes 1 second to generate. If you have open source shiny and there are 10 users on your app and they all want to plot, they will have to wait for each other since the plots will be generated one after the other, which means some users will wait a long time. 

With server pro, you can specify the maximum number of users that can be connected to a single R process (with some other constraints too). Ths "utilization_scheduler" line is what determines this. For example, you can use "utilization_scheduler 3 1 50" which means that at most 3 users can be connected to one R process (so the maximum time a user will wait for their plot is 3 seconds), and if a 4th user comes, they will be in a new R process. I haven't touched on what the other two numbers mean, you should read the docs here

http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#utilization-scheduler
